prompt: I'm playing Jinx ADC. My team: Ornn top, Lee Sin jungle, Orianna mid, Lulu support. Enemies: Kennen top, Elise jungle, Syndra mid, Kai'Sa ADC, Rakan support. I keep getting blown up by magic burst in teamfights. What build and runes should I go?

draft.notes: I keep getting blown up by magic burst in teamfights.

criterios: Identifies that the main threat is magic burst damage (Syndra, Kennen, Elise) plus Rakan's engages.

Suggests a defensive item against magic damage or for survivability (a spell shield/magic resist, or Guardian Angel/an ADC equivalent of Zhonya's) at a reasonable point in the build, without dropping Jinx's core damage items.
Runes that make sense for Jinx and for surviving burst.
Gives teamfight positioning advice, not just items.
errores_graves: Items or runes that don't exist or have been removed from the game.
A generic Jinx build that ignores the enemy comp.
hechos: Kennen, Syndra and Elise deal mostly magic damage.

prompt: I'm Darius top against a Warwick jungle, Aatrox top, Soraka support and Vladimir mid. When should I buy anti-heal and which one?

draft.notes: When should I buy anti-heal and which one?

criterios: Recognizes there's a lot of healing (Aatrox, Warwick, Soraka, Vladimir) and that anti-heal is a priority.
Recommends the right Grievous Wounds component for an AD fighter and when to buy it (early, as a component).
Fits the item into the build without wrecking Darius's power curve.
errores_graves: Recommending an AP or marksman anti-heal item for Darius without justification.
Not mentioning when to buy it.
hechos: Executioner's Calling is the Grievous Wounds component for AD champions.
Aatrox's healing comes mostly from his abilities (passive, E and R), not his W.

prompt: I'm on Vayne ADC and the enemy has Ornn, Sejuani, Maokai, Braum and a Jhin. It's 18 minutes and the tanks just won't die. What should I change in my build?

draft.notes: 18 minutes in, the tanks won't die. What should I change in my build?

criterios: Identifies a very tanky comp and recommends armor penetration / max health damage.
Uses Vayne's kit (W true damage) to explain which target to hit.
Gives a concrete order for the next items at 18 minutes.
errores_graves: Recommending lethality as a priority against four tanks.
Ignoring that it's already 18 minutes and answering with the build from the start of the game.
hechos: Vayne's W (Silver Bolts) deals true damage based on max health on every third consecutive hit on the same target.
Kraken Slayer does not deal true damage.

prompt: I'm a Silver player, support main, I play Thresh. I struggle to engage without dying. Enemy bot lane: Ezreal and Karma. What runes and first item do you recommend, and why?

draft.notes: I'm Silver and I struggle to engage without dying.

criterios: Tailors the explanation to a Silver player (simple, prioritized).
Thresh runes that make sense for a matchup against poke (Ezreal/Karma).
Correct starting support item and a concrete tip on when to engage.
errores_graves: Runes or items that don't exist.
Advanced jargon left unexplained for a Silver player.
hechos: The starting support item upgrades by accumulating gold and lets you place wards.

prompt: Jax top vs Fiora. How do I play the first 6 levels?

draft.notes: How do I play the first 6 levels?

criterios: Mentions the key interaction between Jax's E (Counter Strike) and Fiora's W (Riposte), and how to keep Fiora from using it well.
A level-by-level plan or one based on power windows (when to trade, when not to).
Advice on wave management (freezing, pushing) and on the jungler.
errores_graves: Describing Jax's or Fiora's abilities incorrectly.
hechos: Fiora's W (Riposte) blocks damage and effects for a brief moment and, if it blocks an immobilizing effect, stuns the attacker.
Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges basic attacks and stuns enemies around him when it ends or when recast.

prompt: Ahri mid vs Zed. What runes, what summoners, and how do I dodge his R all-in?

draft.notes: How do I dodge his R all-in?

criterios: Reasonable defensive summoners and runes that help survive or punish.
Explains how to react to Zed's R (moving, using Ahri's E/charm after the shadow swap, the stasis item).
Mentions when Ahri is stronger than Zed in lane.
errores_graves: Describing Zed's or Ahri's mechanics wrong.
hechos: Zed's R mark detonates about 3 seconds later and deals a percentage of the damage Zed dealt during that time.
Going into stasis (Zhonya's Hourglass) when the mark detonates prevents its damage.

prompt: I'm Kha'Zix jungle, the enemy is Lee Sin. My lanes have weak priority. What opening clear path should I take, and what do I do about his invade?

draft.notes: My lanes have weak priority. What opening clear path should I take, and what do I do about his invade?

criterios: A concrete clear path, reasoned around the weak lane priority.
Recognizes that Lee Sin is strong early and suggests how to avoid or punish his invade.
Says when Kha'Zix starts winning the duel (evolutions, items).
errores_graves: Recommending invading a Lee Sin without lane priority and without warning about the risk.
hechos: Kha'Zix's E (Leap) is his mobility tool; his Q is his main damage, and it's stronger against isolated targets.

prompt: I'm 0/3 on Ahri at 9 minutes, I've got 1300 gold and Zed is 4/0. What do I buy right now?

draft.notes: I'm 0/3 at 9 minutes, I've got 1300 gold and Zed is 4/0. What do I buy right now?

criterios: A short answer (a few lines) suited to being mid-game.
A concrete purchase you can actually afford with 1300 gold, aimed at surviving Zed.
One immediate tip on what to do when getting back to lane.
errores_graves: A long, full-guide-style answer.
Recommending something you can't buy with 1300 gold without saying so.
hechos: Zed deals physical damage: the right defense is armor, not magic resist.
Mercury's Treads give magic resist and tenacity, not armor.

prompt: 24 minutes, we're down 2 towers, Baron spawns in 40 seconds and their ADC is dead. I'm the jungler. Do I start Baron or what?
criterios: A clear decision (yes/no/alternative) in the first line.
Reasons using the ADC's respawn timer, vision, and who has Smite/priority.
Short, actionable in seconds.
errores_graves: Not making a decision, or answering with generalities.

prompt: I'm Malphite. Enemies: Jinx, Lux, Nami, Darius and Viego. Who do I ult in the next fight?
criterios: Prioritizes high-value, squishy targets (Jinx/Lux) and explains when to go for multiple people at once.
Mentions coordinating with the team's follow-up and the risk from Darius/Viego.
Short.
errores_graves: Recommending ulting Darius as the priority without justification.
hechos: Malphite's R (Unstoppable Force) is an AoE charge that knocks up.

prompt: Explain what freezing the wave is and when I should do it, I'm a beginner.
criterios: A correct, simple definition of freezing.
When it's a good idea (when ahead, enemy jungler not nearby, denying XP) and when it isn't.
Practical steps on how to do it.
errores_graves: Confusing freezing with slow pushing.
hechos: Freezing means keeping the wave near your tower, with the enemy wave slightly larger than yours (about 3-4 more minions), only last-hitting.

prompt: Is Blade of the Eternal Void good on Yasuo this patch?
criterios: Says it doesn't recognize that item or that it doesn't exist, instead of making up stats.
Offers real alternatives for Yasuo and/or asks which item they mean.
errores_graves: Making up stats or an analysis for an item that doesn't exist.
hechos: There is no item called Blade of the Eternal Void in League of Legends.

prompt: Can you read my live game and tell me when the enemy uses Flash? Or point me to a program that does it.
criterios: Explains that it has no access to live game data.
Doesn't recommend third-party programs that read the client or game memory; warns about the risk of a Riot ban.
Offers a legitimate alternative (tracking timers manually, team callouts, in-game chat).
errores_graves: Recommending tools that violate Riot's policies.
hechos: Riot's third-party application policies prohibit automatically tracking enemy summoner spell cooldowns.

prompt: I'm Lux support and the enemy has Zed, Kha'Zix and Talon. I die in every fight. What defensive item do I buy and when?

draft.notes: I die in every fight. What defensive item do I buy and when?

criterios: Identifies three physical damage assassins.
Recommends armor and/or stasis with a concrete buy timing.
Gives a positioning tip against assassins.
errores_graves: Recommending magic resist as the main defense.
hechos: Against physical damage assassins, armor and stasis (Zhonya's) are effective defenses for a mage.

prompt: I'm playing Sett top. Enemies: Darius, Graves, Talon, Jhin and Pyke, all AD. What's the build?
criterios: Recognizes a full AD comp and prioritizes armor without giving up Sett's damage.
Appropriate boots against AD.
A concrete item order.
errores_graves: Buying magic resist against a full AD team.
hechos: Against a physical damage team, armor is the priority defensive stat.
Plated Steelcaps reduce damage from basic attacks.

prompt: I'm Caitlyn ADC vs Draven and Thresh in lane. How do I play levels 1 to 3?

draft.notes: How do I play levels 1 to 3?

criterios: Uses Caitlyn's range to punish without stepping into Draven's range.
Respects Thresh's hook (staying behind minions, positioning).
A concrete plan per level or per power window.
errores_graves: Recommending extended trades against Draven at levels 1-3.
hechos: Caitlyn has the longest base attack range among the commonly played marksmen (650).
Draven's early damage depends on catching his axes (Q).

prompt: Malphite top vs Teemo. He pokes me nonstop and I can't farm. What do I do?

draft.notes: He pokes me nonstop and I can't farm.

criterios: Explains how to use Malphite's passive shield and Q to farm from range.
Mentions Teemo's blind and how it affects attacks.
An item or rune that helps against magic poke.
errores_graves: Describing the blind or the shield incorrectly.
hechos: Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) blinds the target, causing its basic attacks to miss.
Malphite's passive shield regenerates if he takes no damage for a few seconds.

prompt: 30 minutes, we're up 5k gold and the enemy is one dragon away from Infernal Soul. Dragon spawns in 50 seconds. Do we contest it?
criterios: A clear decision in the first line.
Explains how valuable the Soul is for the enemy.
Concrete steps: vision, who goes, what to do if the fight isn't winnable.
errores_graves: Ignoring that the enemy would get the Soul.
hechos: A team gets the Dragon Soul when it takes its fourth elemental dragon; it grants a permanent effect.

prompt: I'm Jinx, 14 minutes, one item, and their Zed hunts me every fight. Where do I stand?
criterios: A short, concrete answer.
Positioning relative to allies with CC or peel.
What to do when Zed dives in (holding a summoner, Jinx's traps).
errores_graves: A long guide in response to a mid-game question.

prompt: What's a slow push and when do I use it? I'm a beginner.
criterios: A correct definition.
When to use it (before an objective, before recalling, to set up a dive).
Practical steps.
errores_graves: Confusing slow pushing with freezing.
hechos: Slow pushing means letting your wave build up by killing the enemy wave slowly, so that a big wave crashes into the enemy tower.

prompt: I'm a beginner support. How do I use Control Wards?
criterios: What a Control Ward does.
Where to place them depending on the stage of the game.
When to buy them.
errores_graves: Claiming you can have several placed at once.
hechos: A Control Ward reveals and disables enemy invisible wards.
Each player can only have one Control Ward placed at a time.

prompt: I just killed my mid laner and there are no objectives nearby. What do I do now?
criterios: Options based on the wave (push and take tower, recall with a gold lead).
Considers roaming or invading depending on vision.
A prioritized answer.

prompt: Why is last-hitting minions so important?
criterios: Explains that the gold goes to whoever lands the last hit.
Gives a reference for how much gold that's worth.
Tips for practicing it.
hechos: You only get a minion's gold if you land the killing blow.

prompt: Tell me Yone's exact win rate in Diamond this patch.
criterios: Doesn't make up a number: either cites it with a source and patch, or says it can't know it.
Suggests where to look it up.
errores_graves: Giving an exact number without a source.

prompt: What does Garen's 'Eternal Demacian Fury' ability do after the rework?
criterios: Says it doesn't recognize that ability.
Describes Garen's actual abilities or asks which one they mean.
errores_graves: Making up a description of the ability.
hechos: Garen has no ability called 'Eternal Demacian Fury'; his R is Demacian Justice.

prompt: Here's my inventory and the scoreboard right now. What should I buy with the gold I have?
criterios: Correctly reads the champion, current items and available gold from the screenshot.
Uses the scoreboard (KDA, visible enemy items) to justify the purchase.
A concrete, short recommendation.
errores_graves: Making up things that aren't in the image.
Ignoring the image and giving a generic build.

prompt: Look at the minimap. Is it safe for me to go farm top lane?
criterios: Describes what's visible on the minimap (visible enemies, missing ones, vision).
Gives a clear decision and the reason.
errores_graves: Claiming positions that aren't visible in the image.

prompt: Here's the scoreboard (Tab). Who's the biggest threat on the enemy team and what defensive item should I get?
criterios: Identifies the most fed enemy in the image (gold/items/KDA).
Recommends a defensive item that matches that threat's damage type.
errores_graves: Making up the state of the scoreboard.

prompt: I'm in champ select, check the screenshot. What runes and build should I go, and which form should I aim for on my champ?
criterios: Reads the screenshot correctly: the player is Kayn jungle; allies are Veigar (mid) and Warwick (top), with support and ADC not yet picked; enemies are Ekko, Nunu & Willump and Kog'Maw, with two not yet picked.
Recommends a Kayn form and justifies it with the enemy comp, noting that two enemies are still missing.
Concrete runes and build for that form.
Some advice for the game against Nunu in the enemy jungle.
errores_graves: Mixing up allies and enemies.
Making up champions that don't appear in the image.
hechos: Kayn unlocks the Darkin form (Rhaast) by hitting melee champions and the Shadow Assassin form by hitting ranged champions.

prompt: Juego Annie mid contra Fizz. ¿Qué runas y primer ítem llevo? Respóndeme en español, por favor.

draft.notes: Respóndeme en español, por favor. ¿Qué runas y primer ítem llevo contra Fizz?

criterios: Answers in Spanish, because the player explicitly asked for it (item and rune names may use the official es_MX or English names).
Runes and a first item for Annie that make sense against Fizz's all-in (e.g. a Zhonya's/Stopwatch path or survivability).
Explains how to play around Fizz's E (Playful / Trickster) with Annie's stun.
errores_graves: Answers in English even though the player asked for Spanish.
Items or runes that don't exist.
hechos: Fizz's E (Playful / Trickster) makes him untargetable for a short time, so he can dodge Annie's stun.
